heldout_selection_rule: Deterministic, results-blind in its inputs: held-out questions sorted by (number of distinct guideline documents in their pre-registered gold passages, descending; then query_id ascending); the first 10 are selected. Uses gold metadata only -- no retrieval rank, similarity score, or evaluation metric is an input to the rule.

experiments.note: The original-10 and held-out-18 evaluations use different gold standards and different question difficulty. They are reported separately and must not be pooled.

final_interpretation: Production remains pure dense MedEmbed retrieval. BM25 was rejected (P@1 0.10). Hybrid retrieval was not adopted (no configuration beat MedEmbed on a primary metric). Full MedCPT reranking was rejected because it displaced correct top-1 answers on both the original set (3 lost) and the held-out set (4 lost). Selective Policy A improved several metrics on the original 10 and, on the held-out 18, preserved all 10 dense-correct top-1 answers while adding one, but Phase 7 was INCONCLUSIVE: the gain is a single question, the threshold is sensitive to a ~3% perturbation, and no held-out question reproduced the Q4 rescue pattern. Selective reranking is a promising experimental direction requiring further validation, not a proven or production-ready improvement.
limitations: Small evaluation sets: 10 original + 18 held-out questions; no statistical significance is claimed.
Selective Policy A's threshold was derived from the original 10 queries (transductive) and only frozen afterwards.
Held-out Policy A gain is one question (P@1 +0.0556 = 1/18); a +0.0011 threshold change reverses it.
The Q4 structural pattern (relevant evidence outside top-10 but inside top-30) appeared in 0 of 18 held-out questions.
The held-out set is easier than the original (dense Recall@10 0.8241 vs 0.4683); the two sets are not difficulty-matched.
Gold labels were authored by the same agent that ran the experiments, though always before any retrieval was run.
Fact coverage is assessed by deterministic regex over the frozen gold patterns, not by semantic judgement.
This package evaluates RETRIEVAL only; no answer-generation or citation-faithfulness evaluation exists in the repository.
